Send the application to the District Judge, Kurnool.
Make sure it reaches by 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: District Court Kurnool Court Attendant Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: District Court Kurnool Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. Notification No.07/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: VII pass and Inter fail Age limit: 18 to 65 years (as on 1 July 2026) Age relaxation: SC 5, ST 5, BC 5, PH 10, Ex-servicemen 10 Other conditions: Preference will be given to local candidates and candidates with experience in the field. Desirable: Experience in the field

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for District Court Kurnool Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Employees who crossed the age limit of 65 years Employees who took voluntary retirement on medical invalidation, retired on compulsory retirement, dismissed, removed from service or subjected to major penalty Persons convicted and sentenced by a Court for moral delinquency or charged with moral turpitude Persons of unsound mind, deaf, mute, blind or suffering from leprosy or contagious diseases Adjudicated insolvents or un-discharged insolvents

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointments shall be for a period of two years and may be considered for re-appointment based on satisfactory work and physical fitness.

content_sections.heading: How Will District Court Kurnool Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview Interview date will be communicated via postal cover.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Passport size photograph attested by Gazetted Officer Date of birth proof Educational qualifications certificates Post held at the time of retirement certificate Medical fitness and mental alertness certificate Self-addressed postal cover with Rs. 80/- postal stamps

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Court Kurnool Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Submit applications with latest passport size photo duly attested by Gazetted Officer affixed on the application. Attach attested copies of relevant certificates (one set) such as date of birth, educational qualifications, post held at time of retirement, medical fitness and mental alertness certificate. Enclose a self-addressed postal cover duly affixing Rs.80/- postal stamps worth. Send the application to the District Judge, Kurnool. Make sure it reaches by 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the due date and time will summarily be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Court Kurnool Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Court Kurnool Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Court Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Court Kurnool Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Page 4 of the PDF) and send it to District Judge, Kurnool, by post or courier, to reach by 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 65 years (as on 1 July 2026). Relaxation: SC 5, ST 5, BC 5, PH 10, Ex-servicemen 10.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 6,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: VII pass and Inter fail.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Preference will be given to local candidates and candidates with experience in the field.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Employees who crossed the age limit of 65 years. Employees who took voluntary retirement on medical invalidation, retired on compulsory retirement, dismissed, removed from service or subjected to major penalty. Persons convicted and sentenced by a Court for moral delinquency or charged with moral turpitude. Persons of unsound mind, deaf, mute, blind or suffering from leprosy or contagious diseases.
